sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # gunnchOS Wireless Measurement & System Testing Lab > This repo is part of the **gunnchOS wireless engineering spine**: hands-on labs that strengthen the technical foundation behind 7GC, AI-RAN, RF, DSP, MIMO, measurement, and **6G PhD readiness** for target wireless communications engineering programs. Not affiliated with any university.

sections.title: What this is
sections.body: Research and teaching lab for **target wireless communications engineering programs**-aligned skills — built as an independent portfolio project.

sections.title: Why wireless engineering readiness cares
sections.body: Latency, loss, RSSI fixtures — links edge-io-measurement-node.

methods: Methods are the fixture probe and schema in src/gunnchos_measurement. The only sample is results/measurement_data_sample.json with ssid fixture and rssi -65. That is fixture mode, not a field campaign. Cable calibration is still an open checklist item.
